scenario.summary: The BUGSTER threat actor uses jailbroken AI assistants to coordinate multi-stage attacks including WordPress enumeration, targeted brute-force campaigns, and MongoDB exfiltration against educational institutions. The operation leverages automated pipelines for Wi-Fi password cracking via cloud GPUs, credential scraping for cloud secrets, and Python-based command-and-control infrastructure.

hunt.name: AI-Assisted Execution and C2 Tunneling
hunt.description: This hunt examines the execution and command-and-control phases of an intrusion, focusing on behaviors associated with AI-assisted cybercrime toolchains like BUGSTER. It uses a gated flow to first identify network leads to known actor infrastructure before fanning out into behavioral analysis of script execution, utility misuse, and rare credential-scraping processes. We look for specific PowerShell reverse shell signatures, ncat listeners, and automated searches for sensitive environment files and API keys.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, dst_endpoint_ip, dst_endpoint_port, direction, protocol, time FROM hb_network_connection WHERE instr(',' || '{{actor_ips}}' || ',', ',' || dst_endpoint_ip || ',') > 0 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identifies hosts communicating with known actor infrastructure at 162.243.3.92 to establish initial scope.
config.expected_signal: A hit indicates a host reaching out to the actor's primary infrastructure. Silence suggests no known C2 traffic in this window.

config.question: the read-lead verdict identifies at least one host with confirmed network activity to {{actor_ips}}
config.condition: the read-lead verdict identifies at least one host with confirmed network activity to {{actor_ips}}
config.description: Is a gate for the expensive fan-out based on the initial network findings.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, script_name, script_content, time FROM hb_script_activity WHERE (LOWER(script_content) LIKE '%tcpclient%' OR LOWER(script_content) LIKE '%wscript.shell%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identifies script blocks containing reverse shell signatures or AI-generated C2 patterns, filtered by the initial scope.
config.expected_signal: Execution of reverse shell code or VBScript droppers. High confidence when matching scoped hosts.

config.content: SELECT file_name, process_name, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS host_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_file_activity WHERE (instr(',' || LOWER('{{sensitive_files}}') || ',', ',' || LOWER(file_name) || ',') > 0 OR LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%.env%') AND activity_id = 2 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY file_name, process_name HAVING host_count < 3
config.description: Identifies rare processes accessing secrets or environment files across the fleet, characteristic of automated scraping tools.
config.expected_signal: A rare file access event where a non-standard process reads a sensitive configuration file.
